text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 28, 2025) for 125 Vaughan Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Added a new Item 5 to the Property Standards Order (August 28, 2025) for 125 Vaughan Road, Folder Number: 25 217265 PRS 00 IV, as follows: 19.F.1(d) Stairway: Required handrails on stairs or ramps are less than 865mm or more than 965mm high. Required Action: Replace or modify the guard to ensure it meets the required height standard. 2. Confirmed Items 2, 3 and 5 of the Property Standards Order (August 28, 2025) for 125 Vaughan Road, Folder Number: 25 217265 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to September 30, 2026. 3. Rescinded Items 1 and 4 of the Property Standards Order (August 28, 2025) for 125 Vaughan Road, Folder Number: 25 217265 PRS 00 IV.
